about_the_game:
After a meteorite strike, the world of Survive The Fall is caught in an etrenal autumn. Rivaling factions battle für supremacy, while you and other survivors try to restore humanity and unravel the mystery of the 'stasis' that emorged from the catastrophe.

Relive the tension of battles, the beauty of a nature changed forever and the tranquil atmosphere of your home base as a safe haven with the Original Soundtrack for the game.
